summary: {organizer} asks for a break on the room charge so residents can attend the program for free.
realLife: Portland reported working with twenty-seven space-grant partners in FY 2024–25 under a program offering free or reduced-cost facilities for accessible activities.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: a city space-use fee, grant agreement and participant admission policy.
